reviews.t: I'd recommend spraying this either above carpet or in the bathtub
reviews.x: This stuff is a godsend - it works extremely well on both natural hair and wigs/synthetic fibers! Be aware that it will absolutely make your hardwood or non-carpeted floors slippery. I'd recommend spraying this either above carpet or in the bathtub.

reviews.t: Best thing I've found to get those stubborn knots out!
reviews.x: This is the best thing I have found to get knots out of my daughter's long, thick, curly (type 2c/3a) hair.  I spray her whole head down but when I hit a particularly bad knot I hose it down and pick my way through it.  Dont expect knots to fall out with the product but it works really well to help pick your way though the  tangles.  Also leaves my daughter's hair in beautiful curls/ringlets when dries.  Doesnt leave residue or sticky feeling.  Smell is minor and pleasant.

My grandmother used this same spray on me when I was little and now I buy it for my 4 year old daughter and I use it for me too. I’ve been going toward quitting shampoo and this has been helpful for sealing moisture in my dry ends. It’s not the only thing I use- I switch between a few products right now- but I love knowing that these ingredients are safe for humans and horses and it’s formula hasn’t changed in years. I just see it as a very natural product.

For humans and animals both - Mane N Tail products work amazing! I use this on myself as a detangler - as well as our F1B Goldendoodle who has very curly hair! This works great as a detangler, preventing mats in my dog, and keeping our hair soft and smelling great! Highly recommend.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the detangler as highly effective at removing tangles and knots, including on thick, curly, and fine hair.
Many reviewers highlight its great value and affordability compared to other brands.
Several reviewers report it works well on synthetic wigs and cosplay wigs.
Multiple reviewers note it reduces hair fallout, breakage, and grooming time.
A few reviewers mention it leaves no greasy residue and has a mild scent, though one warns it makes hard floors slippery.
